item.title: 2003 Ferrari 575M Maranello
item.description: This black-over-black 2003 Ferrari 575M Maranello is powered by a 5.7-liter V12 mated to a F1 sequential transaxle and features a Tubi Style exhaust system, high-flow catalytic converters, and Supersprint catless headers. item.title: Ex-Roadkill 2015 Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat at No Reserve
item.description: This 2015 Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat was featured in an episode of Roadkill on MotorTrend as a press vehicle from Dodge before its bodywork was later changed to resemble the 1968 Dodge Charger, "General Mayhem," that was used throughout the eponymous series. item.description: This 1994 Lotus Esprit is one of a claimed 624 S4 examples produced from late 1992 to early 1996. item.title: Six-Decades-Family-Owned 1966 Ford Mustang Convertible 289 4-Speed
item.description: This 1966 Ford Mustang convertible was acquired by the seller's parents from their neighbor in 1967, and it was subsequently used by the seller's mother as her daily driver in Southern California until 1999. Delivered from the factory with Ivy Green Metallic paintwork, a black Luxury interior, and a C-code 289ci V8 linked to a four-speed manual transmission, the car has since been repainted and fitted with air conditioning as well as a cassette player. item.title: 10k-Mile 2007 Porsche 911 GT3 RS at No Reserve
item.description: This 2007 Porsche 911 GT3 RS is one of 410 examples built for the US market during a two-year production run, and it has 10k miles following registration history in Oregon and Washington. Powered by a 3.6-liter flat-six linked with a six-speed manual transaxle and a limited-slip differential, the car is finished in orange over black upholstery.
